title: Fix detail-screen flow resubscription and midnight rollover
boundary: **Not in this slice:** splitting MainScreen.kt (S32), the dashboard done-today fields (S13), and adding any dependency.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- `viewModel.trackerDetail(it).collectAsState(initial = null)` (MainScreen) builds a new cold Flow on every recomposition. `collectAsState` restarts whenever it receives a new Flow instance, so the detail screen flickers through `null` ("Tracker not found.") and re-queries Room.
- Summaries capture `LocalDate.now()` once per emission. A dashboard left open past midnight shows yesterday's "today" and streak until some data changes.
- Several later slices (S32, S36, S37, S39) rely on the ViewModel owning the selected tracker id and a shared `today`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM:
- In `TrackerAnalyticsTest`: `streak is kept the day after the last satisfied day and lost two days after` (daily YES_NO target 1, one entry on day D: the streak is 1 with `today = D`, still 1 with `today = D + 1`, and 0 with `today = D + 2`).
- In `DayClockTest`, for `millisUntilNextMidnight(now: ZonedDateTime): Long`:
  - `at 23:59:30 it is 30000`
  - `at 00:00:00 it is 86400000`
  - `on a spring-forward day in America/New_York the day is 23 hours long` (use the DST date in the test's year, and compute the expectation with `Duration.between`)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
No new dependency is needed or allowed in this slice. Keep `collectAsState`.
1. `DayClock.kt`: `fun millisUntilNextMidnight(now: ZonedDateTime): Long = Duration.between(now, now.toLocalDate().plusDays(1).atStartOfDay(now.zone)).toMillis()`. It uses the zone so daylight-saving days are the right length.
2. ViewModel: add `private val _today = MutableStateFlow(LocalDate.now())` and `val today: StateFlow<LocalDate> = _today`. In `init`, launch a loop: `while (true) { delay(millisUntilNextMidnight(ZonedDateTime.now()) + 1_000); _today.value = LocalDate.now() }`. Add `fun refreshToday() { _today.value = LocalDate.now() }`. (`delay` does not count time the device spent in deep sleep, so the timer alone can run late; the resume hook below covers that, and also timezone changes.)
3. ViewModel: add `private val _selectedId = MutableStateFlow<Long?>(null)` with `val selectedId: StateFlow<Long?> = _selectedId` and `fun select(id: Long?)`. Add `sealed interface DetailState { object Loading : DetailState; data class Loaded(val detail: TrackerDetail) : DetailState; object NotFound : DetailState }` and `val detail: StateFlow<DetailState>`, built as `_selectedId.flatMapLatest { id -> if (id == null) flowOf(DetailState.Loading) else repository.observeTrackerDetail(id, today).map { it?.let(DetailState::Loaded) ?: DetailState.NotFound }.onStart { emit(DetailState.Loading) } }.stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), DetailState.Loading)`. This is what stops the "Tracker not found" flash: it only appears once Room has answered.
4. Repository: change `observeDashboard()` and `observeTrackerDetail(id)` to also take `today: Flow<LocalDate>` and use `combine(dao.observe..., today) { bundles, d -> ... TrackerAnalytics.toSummary(bundle, d) / toDetail(bundle, d) }`. Update the ViewModel call sites. `quickLog` uses the ViewModel's current `today.value` instead of `LocalDate.now()`.
5. `MainScreen`: collect `viewModel.detail` once (not inside a function that creates a new Flow per recomposition). Replace the `selectedTrackerId` / `trackerDetail(...)` pair with `viewModel.select(id)` when a card is opened and `viewModel.select(null)` when going back. Show nothing while `Loading`, the detail when `Loaded`, and "Tracker not found." only for `NotFound`.
6. Resume refresh in `MainScreen`: `val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current` (from `androidx.compose.ui.platform`), then `DisposableEffect(lifecycleOwner) { val observer = LifecycleEventObserver { _, event -> if (event == Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME) viewModel.refreshToday() }; lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.addObserver(observer); onDispose { lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.removeObserver(observer) } }`. If `LocalLifecycleOwner` does not resolve with the current Compose version, stop and report it with `slicer note`; do not add a library.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes with the new tests.
- Open a tracker: there is no "Tracker not found" flash. Rotate on the detail screen: still no flash.
- With the dashboard open and a YES_NO tracker logged today, set the device clock to 23:59, wait for midnight, and the done-today state (S13/S38 once they land; for now the "Current" streak value) updates without any interaction. Then put the app in the background, change the clock to the next day, and bring it back: it refreshes on resume.
